description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PTC-02
**Title:** First compared truck name navigates to truck PDP
**Language:** ta

**Description:**
Click the first visible truck name in Popular Truck Comparison and confirm that truck’s product detail page opens.

**Expected Result:**
The browser URL matches that truck’s PDP path for the selected language.

**Steps:**
1. Open Popular Truck Comparison
2. Click the first visible truck name
3. Verify the URL is the matching truck PDP
descriptionHtml:
Test Case ID: TC-PTC-02
Title: First compared truck name navigates to truck PDP
Language: ta

Description:
Click the first visible truck name in Popular Truck Comparison and confirm that truck’s product detail page opens.

Expected Result:
The browser URL matches that truck’s PDP path for the selected language.

Steps:

  1. Open Popular Truck Comparison
  2. Click the first visible truck name
  3. Verify the URL is the matching truck PDP
